items.text: Reap every session's processes and isolate review passes: when a session ends, is aborted or lingers past its result, kill all its descendants (e.g. its own process group), not only the sandbox-exec PID; give each review pass its own temp folder, result path and vendor home, sharing no writable root with builder sessions; tests that a session's grandchild is gone after the run and that the review profile shares no writable root with the builder profile (C1)

Finish Story 3.6's live evidence: after item 35 is in a runner tag, re-run XARABOT_LIVE=1 bun test test/adapters/agent/codex/codex-live.test.ts and record it in docs/maintainer/evidence/epic-3.md with the printed outcome-mapping and resume output (and the resumed run's model); name 2606:4700:440b::ac40:9034 and decide the four denied sdmntpr*.oaiusercontent.com hosts (A2, A3)

Check every composed reviewer's CLI at lane start as the lane's own agent is checked (cliVersion and startCheck: minimum version and effort), so a claude lane with a missing or pre-0.163.0 codex reviewer refuses to start; tests in test/cli/lane-run.test.ts (A5, C3)

Keep a passed review across repeated clean main merges: the passed gate walks back through a chain of runner-recomputed clean merges with main to passed_sha instead of accepting only a direct parent; tests for two and three queue ejections in a row (C2)

Journal review sessions' usage: each review pass's tokens, cost and model reach the journal, on the unit's record or as their own spans, instead of staying on the review step's private track (C5, AR25)

Run the follow-up reviews Stories 3.4 and 3.5 recommend on their named unverified risks (the follow-up pass, a loopback reading tmp/review-findings.md, the passed gate's clean-merge branch, the planning and retro review flow) before the switch after Epic 3 (E1)

Run bmad-correct-course for Epic 3's drift: reconcile spine, SPEC, agent-adapters.md, app-permissions.md and the 3.1 AC with the as-built code (enqueued_sha, review-findings, schema v5, item 29's vendor rule, codex env and profile changes); decide the cap that parks a passing round, takeover re-reviews, codex usage limits with no rate_limits, a no-output watchdog, lane install checking the lane's own agent, a real bmad-build-auto codex canary and the review prompt's agent-config line; route Epic 3's unrouted deferrals (A4, A6-A10, C4, C6, C7, E3)

Consolidate the review plumbing: one shared passed-gate call, allowance re-check and fix-push helper in the session module; share planning and retro ciAndGate; one AGENT_CONFIG_DIRS rule for the write check and the review checkout; one missing-commit fetch helper; take the codex credential file name from the adapter in lane-run.ts (D1, D2)

Close Epic 3's verification gaps: tests for a takeover after a blocking review round and a codex usage-limit turn.failed with no rate_limits (pin today's behaviour); flagged-spec and loopback rehearsals in the cross-vendor suite; fix self-host.md's stale expected sandbox counts and note that pre-v5 awaiting-approval parks need a release (C4, C8)

Tracker, CI and gate housekeeping: decide which file is authoritative for retro action items and bring sprint-status.yaml's 25 earlier items in line; build or decide against the macOS CI job (Epic 1 item 13); add live_evidence_checks to .xarabot/config.yaml so a failed live row holds the next retro (E2, E4, E5)
